items.exampleEn: The reunification of the two villages, which were once one town, took many years.
items.exampleZh: 這兩個原本是同一個鎮的村子，花了很多年才重新合併。

items.exampleEn: Some people think thirteen is unlucky, but it is just a superstition.
items.exampleZh: 有些人認為十三不吉利，但那只是迷信。

items.exampleEn: The old monk was known for his piety.
items.exampleZh: 那位老僧侶以虔誠聞名。

items.exampleEn: People who are oppressed often feel they have no voice.
items.exampleZh: 受壓迫的人常常覺得自己沒有發言權。

items.exampleEn: Many people in the town are anti the new airport.
items.exampleZh: 鎮上很多人反對蓋新機場。

items.exampleEn: Aborigines lived in Australia for thousands of years before others arrived.
items.exampleZh: 在其他人到來之前，原住民已在澳洲生活了數千年。
items.glossZh: 原住民（舊稱，具冒犯意味）

items.exampleEn: The old club split into two, but a new leader reunified it.
items.exampleZh: 那個老社團分裂成兩個，但一位新領袖讓它重新合而為一。

items.exampleEn: Social networking has changed how people make friends.
items.exampleZh: 社群網路改變了人們交朋友的方式。

items.sentenceEn: My grandmother doesn't believe in any superstition.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶不相信任何迷信。

items.audioEn: Our social networking class starts at seven, and you need to bring your own phone.
items.audioZh: 我們的社群網路課七點開始，你需要帶自己的手機。

items.sentenceEn: The museum has a room about the history of the Aborigines.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館有一間介紹澳洲原住民歷史的展廳。

items.sentenceEn: Some parents are anti phones for young children.
items.sentenceZh: 有些父母反對讓年幼的孩子用手機。

items.stemEn: My neighbor never opens an umbrella inside the house because of an old ____.
items.stemZh: 我鄰居從不在屋裡打開雨傘，因為一個古老的迷信。

items.stemEn: The strict teacher ____ her students and never let them speak in class.
items.stemZh: 那位嚴厲的老師壓迫她的學生，從不讓他們在課堂上說話。

items.passageEn: Last month, my grandmother's family was finally reunified after twenty years apart. Twenty years ago, her two brothers moved to different countries. Thanks to social networking, my cousin found them online, and the reunification took place in my grandmother's hometown. My aunt believes in an old superstition, so she chose a "lucky" date for the dinner. My grandmother's older brother, a quiet man of great piety, prayed before the meal. Over dinner, they talked about the hard old days, when a cruel landlord oppressed the poor families in their village. My aunt used to be anti phones at the dinner table, but that night she let everyone take photos.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我奶奶一家人在分開二十年後終於重新團聚了。二十年前，奶奶的兩個兄弟搬到了不同的國家。多虧了社群網路，我的表親在網路上找到了他們，團聚就在奶奶的家鄉舉行。我阿姨相信一個古老的迷信，所以挑了一個「吉利」的日子吃飯。奶奶的哥哥是個安靜又非常虔誠的人，飯前做了禱告。吃飯時，他們聊起以前的苦日子，那時一個殘暴的地主壓迫村裡的窮苦人家。阿姨以前反對在餐桌上用手機，但那天晚上她讓大家盡情拍照。

questions.questionZh: 家人是怎麼找到奶奶的兩個兄弟的？
options: 表親在網路上找到他們

questions.questionZh: 阿姨為什麼選了某個日期吃飯？
options: 因為阿姨相信一個老迷信

items.promptZh: 她的虔誠讓大家很感動。
referenceEn: Her piety moved all of us.
Everyone was moved by her piety.
rubricZh: piety 表示「虔誠」，是不可數名詞，例如 her piety 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.promptZh: 很多學生每天花好幾個小時上社群網站。
referenceEn: Many students spend hours on social networking sites every day.
A lot of students spend several hours a day on social networking sites.
rubricZh: 用 social networking 表示「社群網路」（例如 social networking sites）
「好幾個小時」可寫，例如 hours、several hours 等
